name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-iii-ds-last-battle-part
title: Final Fantasy III (DS) - Last Battle (Part 1)
description:
(Originally named "Cloud Of Darkness (Prelude)", also known as "The Final Battle" or "This is the Last Battle")

Very short loop from the cutscene that precedes the final battle against Cloud of Darkness. It could fit in final maps or... yeah, cutscenes.
Port made by ear, using the DS version as the main reference.
